notes.title: ANDERSON 1.0.0 Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello all! Thank you for the overwhelming support for our full release of ANDERSON. Early feedback has been incredibly helpful, and it appears that performance is still not up to our standards. Today we are releasing a hotfix so that everyone is able to play our game while a bigger, long-term fix in the works.

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Low and Medium Quality settings have been adjusted to offer better performance increase
[*] Adaptive resolution floor has been lowered to offer better framerate as a tradeoff of quality
[*] Camera view distance has been slightly reduced in some situations 
[/list]

notes.title: ANDERSON Update 1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38021511/c15fac63424d8adb68a31640718e9fcebc5dec8a.png[/img]

[h2]Update 1.0.0[/h2]
To our fans: Thank you so much for your continued patience and support. We are excited to announce that ANDERSON is leaving Early Access. Our self-funded passion project between 3 friends has come full circle and reached its completion. We are proud of our accomplishment, and hope you enjoy the conclusion to ANDERSON’s story.

If we can afford to in the future we would love to add more content, however we are happy with the state of the game as is, and have no plans to change it further. We will continue to address game breaking bugs and other larger issues as needed.



[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Downstairs Area Added
[*] New Ending Added
[*] Added new intro
[*] Island scene additions
[*] Improved Hand Collisions
[*] Improved Distance Grab Accuracy
[*] Improved Player Rig spawning
[*] Adaptive Resolution can now be toggled in settings
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Utility room Power map visual bug
[*] Bot downstairs is ungrabbable
[*] Fixed water puzzle mechanics
[*] Respawner in Lab was too big
[*] Added bigger text sheet to utility room paper
[*] Added more light to utility room
[*] Fixed sounds not linked to proper audio mixers
[*] Made gap in lighthouse not walkable
[*] No backface on security room wall
[*] Too much bloom in lab
[*] Can walk through security room wall in waiting room
[*] Make downstairs area dark on start and give tablet earlier
[*] Downstairs lights do not toggle with light controls
[*] Dialogue not playing in onboarding
[*] Rebake lighting on island
[*] Can pull lighthouse lever to cancel critical dialogue
[*] Onboarding missing audio
[*] You can hear audio in First loading scene
[*] Changed the circle lights on the security tube green on puzzle complete
[*] Downstairs spawn makes you face a pole
[*] Several missing colliders
[/list]

notes.title: ANDERSON - Update 0.9.9
notes.content:
Okay Goodie! We were able to find a few more bugs to squash as we continue to develop new content. Our goal is to strike a balance between plussing up the ANDERSON Early Access build and providing our players with the rest of the game. As we move into the holidays, expect less patches, and more teasers for what's to come! We can't wait to share what we've been working on.

Thanks for playing!
Alex

[u]Patch Notes[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Water Puzzle Wonkiness[/b] - During our testing we realized that the water levels for the tanks in the Lab could get thrown out of alignment by rapid inputs. We cleaned the code up here, and it is working better than ever!
[*] [b]Additional Menu Fixes[/b] - We noticed that if the player opened their menu while near any in-game UI, the pointer didn't know which layer to interact with. This has been resolved completely. We will also overhaul the menu system as we move closer to the final release build.
[*] [b]Teleporting Through the Floor 2: Electric Boogaloo[/b] - We have another area where the player was able to teleport through terrain. We have patched this bug for now, and will implement a permanent fix when we refactor teleporting.
[*] [b]Ghost Objects[/b] - We happened upon a few objects in the world that were missing their colliders, so player's could move right through them. Spooky! These have all been fixed.

[/list]

As always we are committed to making ANDERSON the best game it can be. Join our Discord to submit feedback and bugs directly: https://discord.gg/kqacxpA

notes.title: ANDERSON - Update 0.9.8
notes.content:
This is a bigger update addressing a few areas we felt needed some love. We wanted to wait on this patch until it was ready, and now it finally is! Included you'll find several quality-of-life changes, new settings, and updated glove models.

We hope this tides you over as we finish the final segment of the game! Expect exciting new content and puzzles soon!

Thanks for playing!
Alex

[u]Patch Notes[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Fancy New Gloves[/b] - We are excited to show off our new glove models with this update. As we move towards our final build of the game, we will be periodically bringing in our new custom assets, so keep an eye out. You may also notice some minor tweaks to visuals in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38021511/14a34fe5a63f39fc288fae771a476c04d1febcb3.png[/img]

[*] [b]No More Pushback[/b] - We adjusted the way the player's "body" interacts with desks and tables. There was an unintentional/unwanted interaction that pushed players backwards based on the position of the body and not the head, but no more! You can now easily lean over objects shorter than you.
[*] [b]Smooth Turning[/b] - Some players (looking at you Darkhope!) requested a smooth turn option, and we thought it would be a great addition. This can be found in the [i]GENERAL SETTINGS[/i] when in-game. Player comfort is paramount in VR: the more choices available, the more freedom to pick the playstyle that suits you best.
[*] [b]Loader Portals Changes[/b] - To make the gameplay experience better for teleport-only players, we have changed the way entering portals works. Now you can point your teleport destination directly at the portals, and it will load you into the next area. The portal will also turn [b]GREEN[/b] when it is being selected.
[*] [b]Menu Fixes[/b] - We have made 3 menu changes: there was a little wonkiness with the menu pointer functionality, but this has been completely resolved. We have also added confirmation text when returning to the Main Menu screen from the pause menu. Lastly, we fixed a strange error that would only allow the player to return to the Main Menu screen once per fresh boot of the game in some cases.
[*] [b]Scaling Fix[/b] - Addressed strange scaling bug that made objects larger in unexpected ways.
[*] [b]Achievements[/b] - Found a problem stopping players from unlocking achievements. To celebrate, we also added in a few extras!
[*] [b]Keycard Bug[/b] - We fixed a bug where the keycard was getting lost inside the locked cabinet.
[*] [b]Diagonal Movement Fix[/b] - We fixed an unintended interaction where moving diagonally would make you travel faster than intended.
[*] [b]Teleporting Through the Floor[/b] - We have patched a few rare instances where the player was able to teleport through the floor altogether.
[*] [b]Lab Exterior Lighting[/b] - Added a new lighting source to the outside of the Lab.
[/list]

[u]Known Bug List[/u]
In an effort to stay transparent with the community, here is a list of bugs we are aware of. These bugs are tricky to track down and squash, so if you experience them please report them to us. Fixing these issues is our #1 priority.
[list]
[*] [b]Lighting Issue[/b] - There is a strange visual bug that has been occurring at random times on random objects, causing them to either turn completely black, or to shine incredibly brightly. If you encounter this bug please report both which item(s) and the area where it was encountered. Restarting the game should fix this.
[*] [b]Spawning Bug[/b] - In extremely rare cases, there has been a bug that causes you to spawn either in walls or out of bounds as you load a new area. We are actively working on a hotfix to ensure that players will be able to continue gameplay when this occurs, however at this time your best bet is to restart the game and your reset guardian/play area.
[/list]


As always we are committed to making ANDERSON the best game it can be. Join our Discord to submit feedback and bugs directly: https://discord.gg/kqacxpA

notes.title: ANDERSON - Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[h1]Okay Goodie![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38021511/c94fd54e6ffbe5c76c7bdf87868e2a1a9f8150fd.png[/img]

This patch should fix the issue with Distance Grabbing objects with no icon on them. I slimmed down the number of lights in the forest and rebaked all of our lighting throughout the game, this may provide some small performance gains on certain systems. I've also renamed our SteamVR Input bindings to be a bit more clean and clear for those making custom bindings.

We are still hard at work on a performance update and hope to get that out as soon as it's ready.

As always we are committed to making ANDERSON the best game it can be. Join our [b]Discord [/b]to submit feedback and bugs directly: [url=https://discord.gg/kqacxpA]https://discord.gg/kqacxpA[/url]

Thanks for playing!
Garrett


[u]Patch Notes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed distance grabbing with wrong input
[*] Fixed distance grab icon not showing
[*] Updated SteamVR Input Binding naming
[*] Rebaked all lighting 
[*] Reduced amount of lighting in Forest scene
[/list]
